loc_study.name: The Study
loc_study.description: A cramped room lined with overflowing bookshelves. Dust motes drift through a shaft of pale light from a narrow window. A heavy desk dominates the center of the room.

objects.name: Scholar's Desk
objects.description: A sturdy wooden desk with carved legs.
objects.notes: Ink stains cover the surface. A half-written page sits under a paperweight.

contains.name: Unsent Letter
contains.description: A folded piece of parchment sealed with wax.
contains.notes: Addressed to someone called 'M.' — the handwriting is frantic.

contains.name: Desk Key
contains.description: A small iron key with an ornate bow.
contains.notes: Etched with the initials 'R.H.' — fits something in this house.

objects.name: East Bookshelf
objects.description: A tall bookshelf lined with dusty volumes.
objects.notes: One book appears to be lodged in at an odd angle.

contains.name: Hidden Journal
contains.description: A leather-bound journal with a fraying strap.
contains.notes: Tucked behind a false row of book spines. The last entry is dated three weeks ago.

loc_hallway.name: The Hallway
loc_hallway.description: A long, dimly lit corridor with peeling wallpaper. Portraits of stern-faced figures line the walls. Doors lead off in several directions.

people.name: Mrs. Hollow
people.description: A gaunt elderly woman in a faded nightgown, clutching a lantern.
people.notes: The housekeeper. She knows about the hidden journal but won't speak of it unless pressed. Deeply loyal to 'R.H.'

objects.name: Guttering Candle
objects.notes: Sitting on the floor near the bedroom door. Almost burnt out.

loc_bedroom.name: The Bedroom
loc_bedroom.description: A sparse room with a sagging bed and a locked chest at its foot. The window has been boarded shut from the inside.

people.name: Unknown Man
people.description: A man in a traveling coat, slumped against the far wall. His face is obscured by shadow.
people.notes: Carrying a second letter addressed to 'M.' in his coat pocket. Died recently — the body is still warm.

objects.name: Old Bed
objects.description: A simple wooden-framed bed with a thin mattress.
objects.notes: The sheets are rumpled, as if someone left in a hurry.

contains.name: Crumpled Note
contains.description: A folded piece of parchment sealed with wax.
contains.notes: Found under the pillow. Reads: 'They know. Leave tonight.'

objects.name: Iron Chest
objects.notes: The lock matches the key from the study.

contains.name: Emergency Coin Pouch
contains.description: A small drawstring pouch that clinks when shaken.
contains.notes: Contains enough silver for passage on a coach.

loc_kitchen.name: The Kitchen
loc_kitchen.description: A cold kitchen with a dead hearth. The cupboards hang open, mostly bare. Something smells faintly of rot.

objects.name: Pantry Cupboard
objects.description: A tall cupboard with double doors and brass handles.
objects.notes: Nearly empty. A few dried herbs remain.

objects.name: Corner Cupboard
objects.description: A tall cupboard with double doors and brass handles.
objects.notes: This one is still shut. Something rattles inside when you push against the door.

contains.name: Fresh Candle
contains.notes: Unused. Someone stashed it here recently.
